forum.title: STM32CubeProgrammer v2.23 released
forum.best_answer_content: This is an announcement post, if you have any issue or feedback to report please use the main page: [STM32CubeProgrammer (MCUs) - STMicroelectronics Community](https://community.st.com/stm32cubeprogrammer-mcus-30)
forum.content_text:
**We are pleased to announce that STM32CubeProgrammer 2.23 is available**

**What is new in 2.23:**

* AI Assistant : Sidekick is now accessible from STM32CubeProgrammer, with a dedicated access button at the top.

* Native Raspberry Pi support for the Linux Arm 64-bit command-line interface (CLI) package.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a9e034c8-fc22-43ae-9eb3-a84a8e3cd63a.png)

You must choose Linux ARM in the download widget

* Readable File Paths

* Launch After Install

* Online documentation.

* Support for STM32H543/553 devices:

+ Internal memory programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Option bytes programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ OTP programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Core register programming through debug interfaces

+ Automatic mode

+ Serial Wire Viewer

+ Register viewer

+ Firmware encryption/signing

+ OBkey generation/provisioning

+ Certificate generation

+ Debug authentication

+ SFI through debug interfaces

* Support for STM32U335/345 devices:

+ Internal memory programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Option bytes programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ OTP programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Core register programming through debug interfaces

+ Automatic mode

+ Serial Wire Viewer

+ Register viewer

+ Firmware encryption/signing

+ RDP regression with password

* Support for STM32U356/366 devices:

+ Internal memory programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Option bytes programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ OTP programming through debug and bootloader interfaces

+ Core register programming through debug interfaces

+ Automatic mode

+ Serial Wire Viewer

+ Register viewer

+ Firmware encryption/signing

+ RDP regression with password

+ SFI via debug interfaces

+ Key wrapping via debug interfaces

* Support of Key Wrapping for STM32H5Ex/5Fx and STM32U3B5/3C5

* Support of SFIx for STM32H5Ex/5Fx (SFI support on external memory)

**How to get STM32CubeProgrammer 2.23:**

* Under this [link](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeprog.html)

* Or update your current installation of STM32CubeProgrammer using: Help > Software update
